summary: No-effect SOP used as a stable reference endpoint. It passes through the input SOP geometry so upstream edits can be made without changing downstream references.
common_gotchas: No parameters is intentionally true for Null SOP; do not invent controls when validating this card.
Geometry COMPs should reference the Null SOP, not upstream construction operators, so internal SOP edits do not break render references.
Select SOP and Object Merge SOP paths should target stable Null SOP endpoints when referencing geometry across networks.
A Null SOP does not fix invalid or empty upstream geometry; inspect Info CHOP channels such as num_points and num_prims when a render is blank.
Null SOP has no effect on geometry, so use explicit Convert, Fuse, Transform, or Attribute SOPs when the output needs actual modification.
